description: This file defines the SubPanelViewNotes class, which manages the display and interaction logic for a notes subpanel in a SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM module, including rendering headers and process list view functions.

classes.name: SubPanelViewNotes
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the display and behavior of a notes subpanel in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Sets the focus object for the subpanel view.

methods.name: setNotesList
methods.description: Assigns the list of notes to display in the subpanel.

methods.name: setHideNewButton
methods.description: Sets whether to hide the 'New' button in the subpanel.

methods.name: getHeaderText
methods.description: Generates HTML for the header section of the subpanel, including the 'New' button.

methods.name: ProcessSubPanelListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view of notes in the subpanel, including layout editing and inline actions.
